unit_rules.name: The Angel
unit_rules.text: Each time this model makes a Charge move, until the end of the Battle Round melee weapons equipped by this model have +[Lethal Hits]+ and +1 to their =swords= Attacks trait. In addition, friendly +Shattered Legions+ units within 6" that Charge this Battle Round have +[Lethal Hits]+ on their melee weapons until the end of the Battle Round.

unit_rules.name: Bodyguards of the Angel
unit_rules.text: While within 3" of a friendly +Shattered Legions+ +Infantry+ unit, this model has +Lone Operative+.
